Alex: Quick thread — ran a spike-probe comparing replay vs synth with KV cache invalidation conditions
Alex: Replay shows transient p99 jumps (300->600ms) when kvcache invalidation coincides with burst handoff
June: Can you paste the harness command + a tiny log sample?
Alex: Command I used:
```
./harness --mode replay --input sessions.json --rate 200 --warmup 30 --duration 300 --kvcache-ttl 60 --burst-window 2
```
Alex: Tiny log snippet:
```
[00:02:15] req=12345 start=0ms ttf=12ms tokens=32 done=150ms
[00:02:17] req=12346 start=0ms ttf=14ms tokens=64 done=610ms  <-- kvcache miss triggered kernel fallback
[00:02:18] req=12347 start=0ms ttf=13ms tokens=16 done=120ms
```
Tariq: Quick clarifying Q: how are we defining TPOT here? tokens/sec per request or aggregate?
Ben_perf: TPOT = total_tokens / (completion_time - start_time) per request. Good for per-request throughput comparisons. TTFT = time-to-first-token (ms) measured from request arrival.
June: For apples-to-apples we'll need a clear normalization protocol: 1) fixed warmup (30s) 2) tag runs with KV state label (cold/warm/mixed) 3) pick steady window where QPS within ±5% of target 4) compute steady-state goodput = mean(tokens/sec) across that window and report TTFT p50/p95/p99 and completion p50/p95/p99.
Alex: Proposed automated extraction logic: drop first 30s, then slide a 60s window across run, pick the window with lowest var(QPS) and QPS within 5% of target. Use that window for goodput and latency histograms.
Ben_perf: Also record kernel-switch events per 1000 requests and kvcache-eviction events. These explain sudden p99 spikes. Add counters: kernel_fallbacks, kvcache_misses, eviction_rate.
June: Important note — synthetic traffic tends to under-represent prefix reuse; that changes kvcache hit-rate a lot. If you compare synth -> replay without matching reuse distribution you get apples vs oranges.
Tariq: Agree. The replay harness should emit "prefix-reuse" markers and the synthetic generator should be parameterizable for reuse_pct and prefix_length_dist.
Alex: Example normalized goodput calc (for documentation):
```
# in selected steady window:
tokens_total = 4_500_000
wall_seconds = 600
goodput = tokens_total / wall_seconds  # = 7500 tokens/sec
# TTFT p95/p99 extracted from per-request ttf array in window
```
Ben_perf: Also add a metric for "spike-impact" = (p99_window / p50_window) - 1 to quantify how bad a transient is.
June: Action items:
- June: draft SOP for run normalization + example calculations
- Alex: upload artifacts (logs + flamegraphs + kernel-switch traces) to the run bucket
- Ben_perf: add kernel-switch and kvcache counters to harness telemetry
- Tariq: extend synthetic generator to match prefix reuse distributions and emit markers
Alex: Uploaded run tarball: s3://redwood-perf/runs/1766667777-spike-probe.tar.gz :link:
